sources.name: Wikimedia text dumps
sources.notes: Reuse is permitted subject to license obligations; model-training treatment and downstream ShareAlike/attribution compliance require project-specific legal review before promotion to the authorization registry.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg US public-domain works
sources.license: Item-specific; generally US public domain for qualifying works
sources.notes: Only individually verified qualifying works should be considered. Project Gutenberg warns that copyright status can differ outside the US and its main site restricts automated bulk access; use permitted mirrors/catalogs and verify each work before ingestion.

sources.name: Wikidata structured knowledge graph
sources.license: CC0 1.0 for structured data in the main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces
sources.notes: Strong candidate for Fresh's international knowledge graph because Wikidata states that its structured data is CC0 and provides multilingual structured entities, links and references. Production training promotion remains blocked until Fresh's project-specific legal review and corpus privacy/safety/quality/deduplication checks are complete.

sources.name: OpenAssistant Conversations (oasst1)
sources.notes: Human-written, human-rated assistant conversations in 35 languages. Strongest fit for the no-outside-model rule. Import only messages with review_result=true and deleted=false. Owner approval of license terms required before promotion.

sources.name: databricks-dolly-15k
sources.notes: Written by Databricks employees. ShareAlike and attribution obligations need project-specific review before promotion.

sources.name: Wikimedia Wikipedia (per-language subsets)
sources.notes: Human-written. Includes sw, lg, rw, yo, ha, zu. ShareAlike and attribution obligations need project-specific review (same as the existing Wikimedia candidate).

sources.name: Common Corpus (PleIAs)
sources.license: Open-licensed content only; per-document license field
sources.notes: 2.27T tokens of openly licensed text and code. Per-document license must be checked and recorded; import only documents whose license permits training and derivative models.

sources.name: FineWeb-Edu
sources.notes: Provenance concern: pages were selected with a classifier trained on Llama-3-70B annotations, and the web sources carry their own terms. Keep blocked unless the owner accepts that provenance.

sources.name: The Stack v2 (dedup)
sources.notes: Gated: requires accepting terms on Hugging Face. Holds file identifiers, not content, so contents must be fetched separately. Each file's license must be checked. Not importable by this adapter yet.
